title: Composite-number verifier
statement: Given Boolean strings $x$ and $r$, return true if the binary value of $x$ is less than $2$, return false if it equals $2$, and return true if it is even. In every other case, return the negation of the result of the specified number of Euler-liar rounds on the binary value of $x$, using $|x|+3$ rounds with parameter $2$ and randomness $r$.
